_comment: Key information that must match between each zh/en page pair. required_phrases: per page name (home, about, latest daily ...); each item is {zh, en} or {pairs: [[zh, en], ...]} (accepted variants registered as pairs; a page passes an item only if some zh_i is on the zh page AND the same en_i is on the en page; en case-insensitive; whitespace-insensitive). Phrases need >= 4 CJK characters or >= 8 letters; home and about must have entries. event_times: per page, each event maps to a label pattern per language with {T} marking the HH:MM time; the time next to each label must be equal on both pages. profile_hosts: external profile hosts whose links must be identical. Maintained by markjin 生产与发布 (decided by Grok Bot); a PR that changes a registered phrase (on either the zh or en page) must update this file in the same PR; copy changes that touch no registered phrase do not require updating it.
